ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, with a focus on following the money trail to uncover the extent of the issue
questions: How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system, and could lead to major reforms and recoveries of stolen funds.
